svg.title: Coming back to a big session after its prompt cache expired
svg.desc: Mean cost per return. Claude Code: 234 returns, after 60 requests resume as is $8.14, /compact first $6.32, new session + handoff note $2.63, heartbeats, then resume $6.28, heartbeats, then compaction $4.10. Codex: 204 returns, after 60 requests resume as is $3.98, /compact first $2.77, new session + handoff note $1.80, heartbeats, then resume $4.04, heartbeats, then compaction $3.58.
svg.text: Coming back to a big session after its prompt cache expired
Mean cost per return over the requests that follow, for cold returns to sessions of 100k+ tokens in local logs
Claude Code · 234 returns, median context 480k tokens

svg.text: tokprof bench · requests priced at their time · a compaction call is modeled as writing the cold context again plus a 10k-token summary
heartbeats: a ping at 5/6 of the cache lifetime, every 50m on a 1h cache, for up to 6h after the last request; a return within the last ping's lifetime reads the cache
heartbeats, then compaction: the same pings, then at the next ping time past 6h a compaction while the cache is warm; a later return starts from what it leaves
a compaction while the cache is warm reads the context in Claude Code and writes it again in Codex, whose compaction calls read nothing from the cache
